Category 2 - Export & Import.one: Overall rules for export-only registration: minimal data, priority processing and fixed time frames (380th RC, 2017).
nums: Star Export House: Category A / B

pts: A: pesticide already registered for use in India (any purity or formulation): only basic chemistry
B: not registered in India: chemistry plus toxicity, to judge worker safety
Fast Track: with a firm export order; certificate for that quantity only, restriction removable later
Star Export House: accredited as per Ministry of Commerce
All other export-only applications
No separate export registration needed if the product is already registered for domestic use
Export packs may follow the importing country's packaging requirement
No bio-efficacy data is asked for export-only registration
Toxicity: published WHO, FAO/WHO, IARC, USA/EU/Canada/Japan evaluations or MSDS are accepted

watch: Import for export of a product registered in India only from the registered source; an unregistered source needs a firm export order and keeps its quantity limit

2.1 Indigenous manufacture for export u/.one: What to submit to manufacture a pesticide in India only for export, by category.

pts: Firm export order and the product's registration in the importing country
B II, B III, B IV: also registration in a developed country (EU, USA, Australia, Japan, Canada)
Certificate for the order quantity, issued by Secretary CIB&RC; RC approves later
A I (registered in India): chemistry items 1-2 + packaging/label undertaking
A III (registered microbial strain): Table 2 chemistry except 4-6 + undertaking
B I (already registered for export by someone): chemistry 1, 2, 3, 4, 6
B II (not registered in India): chemistry 1-6 + toxicity 1-12 for technical
B III botanical / B IV microbial not registered: all Table 2 chemistry + selected toxicity

watch: Every category needs an undertaking on packaging and label/leaflet as per Insecticides Rules 1971

2.2 Import for export u/s 9(3).one: What to submit to import a technical or formulation only to re-export it.
nums: past import/export details to submit (except Star Export)

pts: Firm export order and the product's registration in the importing country
Certificate shows product names, quantities and compositions imported and exported (468th RC, 2026)

blocks.h: A II: from a source already registered in India
pts: Chemistry items 1, 2 and 6 (composition, properties, source of import)
Undertaking on packaging and label/leaflet

watch: Certificate is issued only after documents and/or sites are verified by a CIB&RC team (357th RC)

2.3 Import of sample quantity for RTT.one: Permission to import small quantities for research, trial and test (RTT), given by the Secretary CIB&RC (380th RC, 2017).

pts: Completed Form C, plus technical bulletin from the inventor / manufacturer
Chemistry, toxicity and bio-efficacy information with a reference (e.g. Pesticide Manual)
Justification for the quantity
Registration certificate or manufacturing licence in the source country
Manufacturer's authorisation to the applicant (and to the supplier, if different)
Coded / unregistered compounds: authentic document from the inventor
RTT technical for registration in India: affidavit on its indigenous-manufacture registration status

watch: Extremely toxic (red triangle) and coded compounds not registered anywhere go to the RC, not the Secretary

2.4 Export of small quantity samples for.one: Application (Form C) to export small sample quantities for research, trial and test abroad (455th RC, 2023).

pts: Exporter details, importing country and overseas importer
Active ingredient / formulation, code or common name, chemical class, Schedule status
Purpose, quantity, type of packing
Manufacturer and manufacturing site in India
